We are looking for a Partner Development Lead based in India to join our AWS Partner team and help our business grow with AWS. We are looking for a creative business development professional with extraordinary energy, passion to learn, and initiative to drive new business for the fastest-growing database in the world, MongoDB. The Partner Programs Lead role will own multiple GTM workstreams with one of MongoDB's strategic partners i.e. AWS, for the entire region. This individual will be accountable for developing a strategy to drive incremental pipeline, increase sales productivity, improve co-sell execution, and launch & drive new sales plays with AWS.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram, India for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Execute GTM (co-sell, co-marketing, product alignment) plays with AWS Cloud to drive incremental Atlas pipeline and revenue.
  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline creation and revenue attainment for Atlas deals with AWS Cloud sales teams.
  • Drive enablement and field alignment activities to convert co-sell plays into closed-won revenue with AWS Cloud.
  • Execute AI-focused sales plays with AWS, driving pipeline and revenue from AI-related Atlas opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Product Management, Legal, Revenue, Finance) to keep plays running smoothly and remove execution blockers.
  • Collaborate with the extended Partner team (Cloud/Hybrid Specialists, Partner Marketing, Partner Architects) to execute plays in the field.

Requirements

  • Working knowledge of the AI/ML ecosystem; generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, vector search/embeddings, and AI agents and familiarity with hyperscaler AI stacks and how partners package and co-sell AI solutions.
  • Able to speak credibly with AWS AI/ML specialist and partner teams about where MongoDB Atlas fits in an AI application stack.
  • Proven track record of carrying and exceeding a pipeline or revenue quota, ideally through a partner/channel co-sell motion
  • End-to-end negotiation experience, including identifying, developing, and executing successful partnerships.
  • Ability to assess technical and commercial feasibility for the partner and MongoDB.
  • 5+ years in a direct sales role or partner/channel role with an Enterprise Software company.
  • Prior experience of working in a heavy sales matrix model is preferred.
  • Prior experience in working with AWS/Azure/GCP is preferred.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Headquarters: Remote

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform teams within the Platform Engineering organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role responsible for the foundational systems that store, ingest, and evolve the data powering ZoomInfo's entire go-to-market product suite.

You will lead a team of senior engineers across two core areas:

•       GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable), spanning scaling, performance, operational reliability, and the change data capture (CDC) systems that capture and propagate data change events downstream.

•       ZoomInfo Data Platform — ZoomInfo's analytical data store (BigQuery), including the ingestion pipelines and onboarding systems that bring new data in and keep it flowing accurately and efficiently, and the processes that ensure customer data deletion requests are handled promptly and compliantly.

This role sits at the foundation of ZoomInfo's data infrastructure — the reliability, scale, and integrity of these systems directly determine how fast we can onboard new data and how confidently we can serve it to customers. You will manage senior technical talent directly, setting technical direction, unblocking hard problems, and holding a high bar for engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

•       Lead and develop a team of senior engineers and tech leads across GTM Store and the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Set the roadmap across both areas, balancing scaling and performance needs, new data onboarding velocity, compliance obligations, security and platform reliability.

•       Build a high-performance engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, and operational excellence for systems operating at large scale.

•       Manage senior technical individual contributors directly — setting expectations, providing technical guidance, and developing career growth paths for staff-level and senior engineers.

•       Serve as a trusted partner to the VP of Software Engineering, contributing to broader platform engineering strategy.

•       Establish clear prioritization frameworks to manage competing demands across scaling, new data onboarding, compliance, and reliability work.

GTM Store

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable) powering the go-to-market data product.

•       Drive scaling initiatives to keep pace with data growth and increasing query/read-write demands from downstream products.

•       Guide architecture decisions to improve performance, latency, and cost-efficiency at scale.

•       Establish and maintain operational best practices — monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and incident response — to ensure high availability.

•       Own the strategy and architecture for change data capture (CDC), ensuring data change events are captured, propagated, and consumed reliably by downstream systems, including the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Guide the selection and evolution of CDC tooling and patterns to support real-time and near-real-time data change propagation at scale.

•       Ensure CDC systems maintain data consistency, ordering guarantees, and fault tolerance under high event volume.

•       Partner with Product and downstream engineering teams to understand data access patterns and evolve the store's schema, APIs, and change event streams accordingly.

ZoomInfo Data Platform

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the ZoomInfo Data Platform — the analytical data store (BigQuery) that consumes and serves data for downstream analytics and product use cases.

•       Own the architecture and roadmap for data ingestion pipelines, including those consuming CDC streams from the GTM Store, that bring new data sources into the platform.

•       Drive initiatives to ease and accelerate the onboarding of new data sources, reducing the engineering lift required to integrate each new dataset.

•       Establish standardized, repeatable ingestion patterns and tooling that shorten time-to-value for new data.

•       Ensure ingestion pipelines are reliable, observable, and scalable to handle growing data volume and variety.

•       Own the systems and processes that handle customer data deletion requests, ensuring they are executed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and related regulations.

•       Partner with Legal/Compliance and Product to evolve data deletion workflows as privacy regulations and customer requirements change.

•       Build observability and auditability into deletion workflows to provide clear evidence of compliance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

•       Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements for scaling, new data onboarding, and compliance work that inform the platform roadmap.

•       Drive enablement programs — documentation and tooling — that help internal teams onboard new data sources faster and with less friction.

•       Represent the GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform in strategic planning conversations and technology decisions with company-wide implications.

What You Bring

Required

•       8+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering or data engineering, with experience operating at a senior leadership level.

•       Experience directly managing senior technical talent — staff engineers, tech leads, or senior ICs — and holding a high technical bar.

•       Strong working knowledge of large-scale operational (e.g., BigTable) and analytical (e.g., BigQuery) data stores and distributed systems, including experience scaling data infrastructure to handle high volume and throughput.

•       Experience with data ingestion pipeline architecture and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Debezium, Kafka Connect, Kafka, or similar streaming/CDC tooling).

•       Experience with data privacy and compliance practices, including handling data deletion / right-to-be-forgotten requests under GDPR/CCPA.

•       Demonstrated ability to balance platform reliability and performance work against feature and onboarding velocity.

•       Proven cross-functional partnership skills with product and business stakeholders.

•       Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership.

Preferred

•       Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data infrastructure, including BigTable and BigQuery.

•       Familiarity with event streaming platforms (Kafka) and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar).

•       Experience building self-service tooling that accelerates data onboarding for internal teams.

What Sets You Apart

•       You lead through people. Your strongest technical asset is your ability to hire, develop, and empower exceptional engineers — and then get out of their way.

•       You connect technology to business outcomes. You see infrastructure investments not as technical projects but as enablers of speed, trust, and better decisions across the company.

•       You are a systems thinker. You see the connections between platform architecture, team structure, process design, and stakeholder experience — and you optimize across all four.

•       You are decisive under ambiguity. Competing priorities, legacy systems, organizational change, and imperfect information don't paralyze you — they sharpen your focus.

e44fce11ca49c2dc.description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. We are looking for an experienced and visionary Engineering Leader to lead a high-performing team building distributed systems that power AI and large language model (LLM) capabilities at scale. In this role, you will define technical direction, foster innovation, and ensure your team delivers impactful, production-grade systems that shape the future of SAPs AI offerings. Description As the leader of a fast-moving and cooperative team, you will guide the design, development, and deployment of cutting-edge AI infrastructure. Youll be responsible for growing and mentoring engineering talent, setting technical priorities, and working closely with cross-functional partners to align on vision and execution. Were seeking someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, can connect high-level strategy to concrete deliverables, and inspires engineers to achieve their best work. Key Responsibilities - Lead and inspire a team of managers and engineers delivering backend systems, APIs, databases, and LLM infrastructure - Define and communicate technical vision, ensuring alignment with product and business goals - Collaborate with product managers, researchers, and architects to translate ideas into scalable solutions - Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement - Provide hands-on technical guidance where needed, ensuring high-quality code and architecture - Oversee projects leveraging modern distributed systems, data platforms, and API frameworks - Build team capabilities through mentoring, recruitment, and career development initiatives Minimum Qualifications - Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related field; advanced degree preferred - 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years in an engineering leadership role - Proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in production - Strong understanding of AI/ML and/or LLM systems and their application in real-world products - Experience managing teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments - Strong decision-making skills and ability to balance technical depth with business priorities - Excellent English communication skills and ability to lead in global, multicultural environments Preferred Qualifications - Experience scaling engineering teams and processes in enterprise environments - Open-source contributions or engagement in the AI/ML community - Familiarity with up-to-date development practices, CI/CD, and cloud-native architectures Why Join Us - Lead a team building cutting-edge AI systems with global impact - High-trust, high-autonomy culture with minimal bureaucracy - Collaborate with senior engineers and AI experts in a mission-driven environment - Play a central role in defining SAPs AI strategy and delivering transformative capabilities Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly team-oriented team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. We win with inclusion SAPs culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone regardless of background feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities.
